# RoboCairn

> Compare paired recorded observations and retain regressions and unresolved dimensions.

- [Quick start](README.md#offline-quick-start): HTTPS clone, venv and local wheel installation.
- [For AI agents](README.md#for-ai-agents): purpose, minimal Python call and error contract.
- [Troubleshooting](README.md#common-errors-and-missing-prerequisites): missing prerequisites and recovery.
- [Request schema](docs/schemas/request.schema.json): suite and optional paired batches.
- [Response schema](docs/schemas/response.schema.json): result envelope and report.
- [HTTP interface](openapi.yaml): POST /check on the local service.
- [Readable guide and evidence limits](docs/README.md): interfaces and comparison evidence.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): hello@robocairn.com.

Needs Git for checkout; Python 3.10+ with venv/pip for installation. Clone and activate
a venv using the quick start before this one-line installation from the repository root:
python -m pip --isolated install --no-index --no-cache-dir --no-deps wheels/robocairn-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl

Run: robocairn check fixtures.json
The manual fixture example returns UNKNOWN, exit 3 and five rows with unknown dimensions.
OK / exit 0 means a valid complete comparison and can still contain regressions.
ERROR / exit 2 has report=null, error.code and error.message; fix the named cause.
ARGUMENT_ERROR includes an example and --help; INVALID_INPUT identifies input/file errors.
HTTP invalid input is 400; oversized bodies 413; wrong media type 415.
INTERNAL_ERROR gives UNKNOWN with no report (HTTP 500 / CLI 3); do not accept it.
Python callers receive input/loading exceptions; see the agent instructions before retrying.
No simulator executes. No robot safety assessment or authenticated provenance is provided.
